title: Real estate valuation and diligence bundle
description: Tenant certification, title and lease evidence, independent valuation, and a real-estate ontology sliver.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: real-estate-valuation-diligence
  title: Real estate valuation and diligence bundle
  description: Tenant certification, title and lease evidence, independent valuation, and a real-estate ontology sliver.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-rec-01
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/real-estate
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs:
        - real_property.property_address
        - real_property.premises_description
        - real_estate_party.tenant_name
        - lease.current_monthly_rent
        - lease.lease_end_date
        - lease.security_deposit_amount
        - title_record.commitment_number
        - rent_roll.tenant_entries
      relationshipIds: [describes, has_party, involves, evidenced_by, summarized_by]
  forms:
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/real_estate/tenant_estoppel_certificate, role: review }
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/real_estate/lease_agreement, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/real_estate/real_estate_transactions_title_commitment, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/real_estate/rent_roll, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/real_estate/purchase_agreement, role: supporting }
  bindings:
    - id: property-to-valuation-subject
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/real_estate/tenant_estoppel_certificate, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/4/fields/0 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-rec-01, path: /spec/nodes/0/inputSchema/properties/workflowFields/properties/subject_property }
      ontologyPropertyRef: real_property.property_address
      direction: input
    - id: rent-to-income-analysis
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/real_estate/tenant_estoppel_certificate, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/2/fields/0 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-rec-01, path: /spec/nodes/0/inputSchema/properties/workflowFields/properties/income_and_expense }
      ontologyPropertyRef: lease.current_monthly_rent
      direction: input
    - id: certificate-date-to-valuation-date
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/real_estate/tenant_estoppel_certificate, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/0/fields/0 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-rec-01, path: /spec/nodes/0/inputSchema/properties/workflowFields/properties/valuation_date }
      ontologyPropertyRef: document.issued_at
      direction: input
    - id: tenant-to-independent-derivation
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/real_estate/tenant_estoppel_certificate, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/3/fields/0 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-rec-01, path: /spec/nodes/2/prompt }
      ontologyPropertyRef: real_estate_party.tenant_name
      direction: review
